name: Free Online File Encrypt & Decrypt Tool - ATools
description: Free online file encrypt & decrypt tool: Securely encrypt any file with AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2 locally, export compact binary (.enc) or JSON, and decrypt anytime to restore the original file.
seoDescription: Free online file encryption and decryption tool. Uses AES-256-GCM industrial-grade encryption with PBKDF2(SHA-256) key derivation to encrypt any file locally in the browser. Exports compact binary encrypted packages (.enc) with zero size bloat, restoring original filenames and extensions; also supports JSON output and legacy compatibility. Pure client-side processing without uploading files.
